title: Freight Terms Glossary: Trucking and Shipping Definitions From Federal Sources
excerpt: Trucking and shipping terms sorted by source: those defined in federal statute and regulation, those with no federal definition, and the words that mean different things in different parts of the rules.
meta_description: A freight terms glossary covering carrier, broker, bill of lading, LTL, GVWR and accessorial, separating federal definitions from industry usage.
